name: claude-replicant
description: Capture complete Claude Code projects and natively resume restored sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate repositories with Claude Code memory.
interface.longDescription: Claude Replicant creates integrity-checked capsules containing a repository plus Claude Code sessions, memory, agents, plans, and configuration, then path-remaps and restores sessions for native Claude Code resume on another computer.
defaultPrompt: Back up a repository and its Claude Code state to a capsule store.
Plan a repository and Claude-state restore to isolated destinations.
